nūna: [Nicchaya]  CL=7 The word “nūna” is an indeclinable particle that does not inflect for gender or case. Though it may appear in contexts of certainty, supposition, or doubt — such as when one makes a decision (nicchaya), draws a conclusion (anumāna), or asks a question (pucchā) — it does not directly mean these concepts.
nūpama: [Na+upamā] (ti) CL=7 He who is "without comparison" ;  incomparable.
nūpura: [Ūna+pūra(=pūra+ṇa)]  CL=7 (1) An anklet — an ornament worn around the ankle. (2) A bracelet — an ornament worn around the wrist.
